Stations come in five types: boiling pot, grill, frying pan, steamer, and cutting board. Overnight, [[Cuisines]] are prepared by putting their respective [[Ingredients]] into the proper type of station. Only a limited number of station can be selected each night, so choose wisely! Increasing izakaya's level allows for more station to be utilized. Multiple instances of the same type of station can be brought to increase cooking efficiency as needed. Stations are broken down into sets that have varied cooking speed and unique effects. ==Default Set== ===How to Unlock=== This set of station is unlocked by default. ===Effect=== This set of station has no unique effect.
IconDescription
[[File:KitchenwareDefaultBoilingPot.png]]A common boiling pot. Made from ancient Chinese pottery, it accumulates heat and pressure well, making it useful for stewing ingredients effectively. A very handy tool for all chefs.
[[File:KitchenwareDefaultGrill.png]]A common grill. Its meshed surface conducts heat to food quickly when lighted. Now you can enjoy the taste of the wild! Supposedly can put a smile on every dad's face.
[[File:KitchenwareDefaultFryingPan.png]]With enough oil, this baby can deep fry anything and everything! The finished product is always delicious and crispy. Watch your cholesterol though.
[[File:KitchenwareDefaultSteamer.png]]Steaming is a revolutionary technology. It can cook several layers of food while keeping most nutrition! A brilliant choice for those who want to be healthy!
[[File:KitchenwareDefaultCuttingBoard.png]]The go-to choice for cold plates! Handy tool for raw fish, raw meat, or salad. It can preserve the ingredients' "original" taste.
